PurchaseOrderItem.name: PurchaseOrderItem
PurchaseOrderItem.description: Represents an individual line on a parent Purchase Order, detailing a specific product or service being procured. It captures the core transactional data including the Quantity, UnitPrice, a reference to the Product, and the calculated LineTotal. This object is available in API version 65.0 and later.

PurchaseOrderItemNumber.description: A unique identifier for the product in the purchase order.

PurchaseOrder.description: The parent purchase order associated with the product.

ProductId.description: The Id of the product associated with the purchase order.

PricebookEntry.description: The pricebook entry that defines the price for the specified product.

ListPrice.description: The list price of the product.

DiscountPercentage.description: The percentage of discount applied to the unit price of the product.

NetUnitPrice.description: The price of the product per unit after applying discounts.

OrderedQuantity.description: The number of units ordered for the product.

QuantityUnitOfMeasure.description: The unit of measure for the ordered quantity.

TotalAmount.description: The total cost for the specified product.

StatusCode.description: The current status of the product in the purchase order.

RequestedDeliveryDate.description: The requested delivery date for the product.

ShippingLocation.description: The location to which the product is to be shipped.

ShipToContact.description: The contact associated with the shipping location.

ShippingAddress.description: The address to which the product is to be shipped.

QuantityReceived.description: The quantity of the product received to date.

AdditionalInfo.description: Additional notes or remarks related to the product.
